titleZh: 純潔 ↔ 玷污｜白袍對墨汁
hook: chaste／immaculate 穿白袍進場，besmirch／blemish／defile 提墨汁——洗衣店老闆開始報價。
script: 潔淨隊：chaste／pristine／immaculate／unsullied。玷污隊：besmirch／blemish／defile／taint／sully。口令：白袍寫「無瑕」，墨汁寫「一滴定生死」。

members.senseAnchor: morally pure (especially not having experienced sexual intercourse); pure and simple in design or style
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 白袍: chaste walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「白袍」出場：chaste 一上場梗就黏住——純潔的。
